alkylation_reagent: alkylated with iodoacetamide for 1 h at room temperature (RT)
cleavage_agent: SPT solutions were prepared and digested with trypsin using 2 different approaches.
collision_energy: Peptide fragmentation/identification was done with a top 12 method and a normalized fragmentation energy at 27%.
enrichment_method: After centrifugation, peptides were enriched and desalted using 100 μl Pierce C18 Tips (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
instrument: directly coupled via nano electrospray to a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization_type: directly coupled via nano electrospray to a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: inferred: Quantitative data presented here were based on signal intensities of identified peptides.
mass_analyzer: inferred: directly coupled via nano electrospray to a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ptm: Fixed modification: carbamidomethylation (C), variable modifications: deamidation (NQ), oxidation (M).
reduction_reagent: Samples were then reduced with dithiothreitol (DTT) at 60 °C for 1 h
